annotations.title: Gold price on a past date

description: The gold price on a past date, for records such as a tax return, an inheritance or a purchase: the world price of fine gold in any currency (FiLot's own daily record, kept since 22 Oct 2026: the day's last reading) and, for Indonesia, the dealers' Antam buyback price that day (stored since 25 Sep 2026). Signed, with a link to check it. A record of the price, not advice.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code for the world price. Default USD.

lang.description: Answer language: id = Bahasa Indonesia, en = English (default).
